name: Repository
description: Four agent runs on one small library, read as a code forge shows them: pull requests, issues, discussions and agents in tabs filtered on every field, each pull request's story with its pushes, reviews and merge, the same backlog issue compared run by run, and every run's activity on its own clock.
data: One folder per run of a team of agents working the same backlog of one library, so issue #3 of one run is issue #3 of another. manifest.json gives the run's setup under keys that changed between runs (run or id, started or started_at, agents or team, approvals, required_approvals or policy.approvals, timezone). events.jsonl holds the forge's events (issue.opened, pr.opened, push with its diff, review, comment, pr.merged, pr.closed, pr.reopened); r4 wrote schema 2, which renames type, ts, actor, labels, fixes, body and diff, writes epoch milliseconds and capital verdicts, and ends in a line cut off when the run stopped, which the reader reports. r3 exported its forge as CSV tables in local time, a commit's diff in a quoted cell over several lines, and reviews.json. board.jsonl holds the discussion and agents/<name>.jsonl each agent's transcript, whose last words are its sign-off. Some events were redelivered or logged late, a review comes from an account that is gone, a linked issue or a number of approvals is free text, and a pull request without an area takes its issue's.
